name: Dirty
summary: The Dirty game will have an interesting exciting plot, many interesting styles and mechanics for a full-fledged comfortable game.There are memorable characters in the game, as well as epidemic monsters.You will have to solve puzzles to get to the next location, or break through to the breach, as well as the game contains a system for changing the plot of your choice, depending on how the dialogue with one or another character enters.This game also contains 2D and 3D graphics.The game features crafting items.:first aid kit, weapons, repairs, upgrades.
